The classified differences list is truncated; no individual native discrepancy, route continuity, junction/crossing ownership, omission or independent registration review is established by this packet. External schema status is unestablished. Source and electrical correctness remain unverified. Team9 sealed review records all 171 raw-presence differences and the first 120 of 123 normalized differences; the remaining three normalized differences are not individually enumerated and remain unassessed. It records 32 wiring findings. A human-approved note-group origin normalization retains content and indentation but does not certify original absolute position. Only the reduced full-page overview was viewed; 92 paths, 59 nets, 34 junctions and 89 crossings are inventory, not completed review.
